title: State integrals for the quantized $\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ Chern-Simons invariant
summary: Previous work of the author and N. Reshetikhin defines an invariant $\operatorname{Z}_{N}^ψ(K, ρ, μ)$ of a knot $K$, a representation $ρ: π_{1}(S^{3} \setminus K) \to \operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$, and a logarithm $μ$ of a meridian eigenvalue of $ρ$. It can be interpreted as a geometric twist of the Kasahev invariant or as a quantization of the $\operatorname{SL}(\mathbb{C})$ Chern-Simons invariant and is defined using a discrete state-sum involving quantum dilogarithms. In this paper we show how to express $\operatorname{Z}_{N}^ψ(K, ρ, μ)$ as a sum over contour integrals in a space…
